title: campanula rotundifolia subsp. pinifolia
intro: Campanula rotundifolia subsp. pinifolia, commonly known as Scottish heather, is a flowering plant species within the Campanula genus. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate conditions like arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Scottish heather include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Campanula rotundifolia subsp. pinifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
